en_index.title: Add sample-making and development costs
en_index.summary: Add a "sample-making and development costs" section to the existing machining quotation tool, so the owner can itemize costs for new products. Items include machining program writing, jig/fixture design and fabrication, materials and consumables, trial cutting and testing, internal inspection, and outsourced testing or third-party certification. Each item is priced by hours × rate, quantity × unit
